recommendation.meaning: Can share grass or earth material basis, but not evidence that existing candidate is seam-safe or all patterns should be identical. Maintain world origin 0 and assembled-map QA.
recommendation.curb_note: 15 curb IDs include previously unseen orientations and corners; existing narrow-stone material is not proof of shape coverage. Exact aliases may reuse geometry evidence but all external contacts still need validation.
recommendation.transition_note: Grass/earth transitions and grass-only variation tiles are conservatively grouped together; they need per-ID source masks and shared global materials, not rectangular scope masks. No new classifier/mask has been implemented or validated here.
recommendation.special_semantics: No unambiguous water or water-surface, regular silver-brick paving, or floor-painted black pit was established in these 70 atlas frames. Coarse-rock tiles surround a stairwell entrance in original static scenery context. The central stairs/pit are a separate scenery object, not painted into these floor frames. Transparent map gaps alone do not establish a hole. -426 dark mark remains unknown.

adjacency.method: Full source world rectangles; right/left and bottom/top exact shared coordinate, positive interval overlap. Each physical contact once, half-edges supported; floor-only pre-occlusion.

limits: Visual semantics are manually read, not authoritative game labels.
No replacement export or whole-map boundary pass completed.
Full-frame alias is exact RGBA including dimensions; never collapse signed ownership keys.
Adjacency records touch interfaces, not overdraw intersections or rendered object occlusion.
